chains.title: Frostcap Fever
chains.type: gathering -> mystery -> light combat -> town consequence
chains.summary: A safe mushroom-gathering job becomes a useful first field run for Bin's returning party.

steps.label: Guild Request
steps.text: Collect Frostcap Mushrooms from the Frostwood edge.

steps.label: Map Seed
steps.text: Use Frostcap Grove as the route.

steps.label: Warm Snow
steps.text: Mushrooms grow in a perfect circle around warm snow.

steps.label: Light Battle
steps.text: Use the Frost Slime Nest battle card or resolve manually.

progressTriggers.log: Quest pulse: the grove fight is handled.

steps.label: Return
steps.text: The Frosted Mug can make Warm Stew again.

followUpHooks: One mushroom does not rot. It hums when Bin touches it. Promote only as yellow-risk content.

chains.title: The Ledger of the Ghost
chains.type: town comedy -> social challenge -> optional duel
chains.summary: Corvin needs proof that Bin is alive enough to sign guild forms.

steps.label: Paperwork Problem
steps.text: Gather signatures proving Bin is alive.

steps.label: Required Signatures
steps.text: Garr, Tessa, Lysa, and the Brinna Twins each sign for different reasons.

steps.label: Dain's Claim
steps.text: Dain says Bin is exploiting a dramatic return loophole.

steps.label: Public Choice
steps.text: Ignore Dain or roast him publicly.

progressTriggers.log: Quest pulse: Bin turns the paperwork duel into a public laugh.

steps.label: Stamp Restored
steps.text: The guild stamp finally accepts Bin's name.

chains.title: Warm Lights, Cold Hands
chains.type: supply problem -> escort -> ambush -> hub repair
chains.summary: The missing firemoss shipment needs a short supply-trail run before Frostbitten's burners dim.

steps.label: Shortage Posted
steps.text: Tessa posts the firemoss shortage as a local priority.

steps.label: South Gate
steps.text: Choose who watches the sled and who scouts ahead.

steps.label: Broken Sled
steps.text: Repair, search, or abandon a damaged carrier sled.

steps.label: Snowblind Ridge
steps.text: Use Bandit Taxmen or Wolf Pack at Bent Pine.

progressTriggers.log: Quest pulse: Snowblind Ridge is clear enough for the sled.

steps.label: Cache Return
steps.text: Return the firemoss cache to town.

chains.title: Ironhand Errand
chains.type: forge repair -> material hunt -> recipe unlock
chains.summary: Hilda needs frost-resistant binding material before the forge can repair winter gear reliably.

steps.label: Bad Iron
steps.text: Hilda explains the repair queue and bad iron shipment.

steps.label: Grip Wraps
steps.text: Gather wolf pelts or bear hide for winter grip wraps.

steps.label: Forge Check
steps.text: Run a crafting check or spend extra material.

steps.label: Field Test
steps.text: Use the repaired gear in one fight or travel segment.

progressTriggers.log: Quest pulse: Hilda's winter gear survives a field test.

steps.label: Recipe Card
steps.text: Hilda writes down a basic cloak recipe, badly.

chains.title: Thunder Needs a Voice
chains.type: Bowy side job -> trail clue -> battle -> character beat
chains.summary: Bowy follows a trail of old crossbow bolts toward a wolf den. Keep Garr clues soft unless GM promotes them.

steps.label: Broken Bolt
steps.text: Bowy finds an old bolt that warms in his hand.

steps.label: Frozen Creek Trail
steps.text: Use the Frozen Creek Trail map seed.

steps.label: Hunter's Marker
steps.text: A marker suggests someone knew this route well.

steps.label: Wolf Den
steps.text: Use a wolf battle set or resolve manually.

progressTriggers.log: Quest pulse: Bowy's wolf den trail is resolved.

steps.label: Quiet Return
steps.text: Bowy decides what kind of archer he wants to be.

chains.gmNote: Do not force Garr's hidden truth. This is a soft character beat.

chains.title: Three Silver and a Funeral Discount
chains.type: rival comedy -> small jobs -> social reward
chains.summary: The Brinna Twins claim Bin's old three-silver debt accrued emotional interest while he was missing.

steps.label: Debt Claim
steps.text: Hear the twins' itemized argument.

steps.label: Receipt Hunt
steps.text: Search town for proof of the original debt.

steps.label: Tiny Jobs
steps.text: Do one tiny helpful town task.

steps.label: Public Arbitration
steps.text: Let Lysa or Corvin arbitrate the absurd interest.

progressTriggers.log: Quest pulse: Bin survives arbitration by making himself the punchline.

steps.label: Friendly Rivals
steps.text: Turn the debt into a recurring friendly rivalry.
